capabilities: Calculate formulas, units and matrices in a local worker
Export worksheets as vector PDF or MCDX files
Preserve unsaved work in recovery copies on save conflicts
extras: Desktop-only; the manifest keeps a desktop-only flag and mobile is not supported. Korean-language documentation is available. All calculation is local with no telemetry. Verified only on Linux desktop and a PC browser web session; Windows workflows and crash recovery are unverified.
problem: Obsidian has no way to edit and compute mathematical worksheets with formulas, units and matrices inside the vault.

relations.evidence: The TypeScript plugin connects the SDK to Obsidian's Vault, views, commands and settings.

summary: Math worksheet editor that creates, calculates and exports .mathfolio documents with a local Rust engine, and opens legacy .mathcraft and .mcdx files.
